name: Gun Ei Chemical Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Gun Ei Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries make and sell synthetic resins and fibers in Japan and internationally through Chemicals, Food and Real Estate Utilization segments. Products include RESITOP resins for photoresist and electronic materials, phenolic resins, reactive polyimide, high purity bisphenol F and NFURAN for curing furan resin binders. It also provides staffing services and leases real estate. Dating from 1946, it has its headquarters in Takasaki, Japan.
